tree:
# Synthetic customer-support tree for the public conformance fixtures. Written by hand for this purpose only —
# no dataset, no real product. experiments/export_public_conformance.py runs the reference implementation on it.
id: root
label: root
description: ''
label_scheme: letters
children:
  - id: billing
    label: billing
    description: charges, refunds, invoices and ways to pay
    options:
      - id: refund-status
        kind: answer
        label: refund status
        description: asks where a refund is or when it arrives
        text: Refunds reach the original payment method within 5 business days of approval.
        origin: seed
      - id: invoice-copy
        kind: template
        label: invoice copy
        description: asks for a copy of the invoice for an order
        template: "The invoice for order {order} has been sent to {inbox}."
        slots:
          - name: order
            instruction: the order number in the request, or "unknown"
          - name: inbox
            instruction: fixed
            fixed: the email address on the account
        origin: seed
      - id: payment-methods
        kind: answer
        label: payment methods
        description: asks which cards or wallets are accepted
        text: We accept major credit cards, debit cards and bank transfer.
        origin: seed
  - id: shipping
    label: shipping
    description: where a parcel is, how long delivery takes and what it costs
    options:
      - id: track-order
        kind: template
        label: track order
        description: asks where an order is now
        template: "Order {order} is on its way; the tracking link is in your confirmation email."
        slots:
          - name: order
            instruction: the order number in the request, or "unknown"
        origin: seed
      - id: delivery-time
        kind: answer
        label: delivery time
        description: asks how many days delivery takes
        text: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days.
        origin: seed
      - id: shipping-cost
        kind: answer
        label: shipping cost
        description: asks what shipping costs
        text: Shipping is free above 50 and 5 below that.
        origin: seed
  - id: account
    label: account
    description: signing in, security and profile details
    children:
      - id: security
        label: security
        description: passwords and sign-in protection
        options:
          - id: reset-password
            kind: answer
            label: reset password
            description: cannot sign in or wants a new password
            text: Use "Forgot password" on the sign-in page; the link is valid for one hour.
            origin: seed
          - id: two-factor
            kind: answer
            label: two factor
            description: asks how to turn on a second sign-in step
            text: Turn on two-step sign-in under Settings, then Security.
            origin: seed
      - id: profile
        label: profile
        description: the details stored on the account
        options:
          - id: change-email
            kind: procedure
            label: change email
            description: wants the account email changed
            steps: "Confirm the current address, send a code to the new one, and switch only after the code is entered."
            origin: seed
          - id: close-account
            kind: answer
            label: close account
            description: wants the account deleted
            text: Accounts are closed from Settings, then Privacy; data is removed after 30 days.
            origin: seed
  - id: returns
    label: returns
    description: sending an item back
    options:
      - id: return-policy
        kind: answer
        label: return policy
        description: asks whether and until when an item can be returned
        text: Items can be returned within 30 days in their original condition.
        origin: seed
      - id: return-label
        kind: template
        label: return label
        description: asks for a label to send an item back
        template: "A return label for order {order} is attached; drop the parcel at any post office."
        slots:
          - name: order
            instruction: the order number in the request, or "unknown"
        origin: seed
  # No children or options on purpose: a category with no habits yet, which the traverser skips without a call.
  - id: warranty
    label: warranty
    description: repairs and replacements under warranty
